VI.description: Places a Call Library Function Node on the block diagram of the VI behind VI reference and configures it by VI Server\3A library path\2C function name\2C stdcall (WINAPI)\2C run in any thread\2C and parameter info (element 0 is the return value). Returns the node's terminals in LabVIEW's order\3A 0 path in\2C 1 path out\2C 2 error in\2C 3 error out\2C 4/5 return value\2C then an input/output pair per parameter.

Control.description: The VI that receives the node.
The DLL. A bare name such as user32.dll is searched for by Windows.

Control.type: array{cluster{string.Parameter Name,int32.Num Dimensions,uint16{Numeric,Array,String,Waveform,Digital Waveform,Digital Table,ActiveX,Any,Instance Data Pointer,Void}.Parameter Type,uint16{I8,I16,I32,I64,U8,U16,U32,U64,SGL,DBL,PTR INT,PTR UINT}.Numeric Type,uint16{By Value,Pointer To Value}.Param Passing,uint16{Array Data Pointer,Array Handle,Array Handle Pointer}.Array Passing,uint16{C String Pointer,Pascal String Pointer,String Handle,String Handle Pointer}.String Passing,uint16{By Value,Pointer To Value}.Adapt Format,uint16{ActiveX Variant Pointer,IDispatch* Pointer,IUnknown* Pointer}.ActiveX Types,bool.Const (unused),string.Minimum Size}.Parameter Info}
Control.description: The ParamInfo property of the node. Element 0 is the return value\2C the rest are the parameters in C order.
Nothing is created when this carries an error.

Indicator.description: error in or the first VI Server error.
